skill.summary: Provides keyword research, on-page optimization, content improvements, and technical SEO advice to enhance website search performance.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of SEO Optimizer Skill.
- Supports keyword research including long-tail and competitor analysis.
- Provides on-page SEO recommendations: title tags, meta descriptions, header structure, and internal linking.
- Offers content optimization suggestions for keyword density, readability, and semantic keywords.
- Includes technical SEO checks: site speed, mobile optimization, schema markup, and Core Web Vitals.
- Features helpful commands for keyword suggestions, optimization tasks, and meta writing.
- Contains an actionable SEO checklist for titles, meta descriptions, headers, and content.
